reason: A is upfront that it can't promise an A1C drop, admits the small sample and untracked medication in the body rather than fine print, and answers my actual quit-risk worries (menu boredom, swaps, no contract, skip/cancel, a call with the dietitian, order deadline). B has unfilled placeholders, leads with the 0.6 drop in bold while burying the caveats in a footer, and its headline feels like the kind of health promise I've learned to distrust.
